# Integrate Medical Document Parsing

The calls themselves: where they live, what they need in their headers, every operation, and one request written out in full.

## Hosts

- `https://api.eka.care` Production server
- `https://api.dev.eka.care` Development server

## Auth and headers

Get a token first: [Authentication](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/auth/getting-started).

- `auth`: HTTP bearer. Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
- `authApiKey`: HTTP bearer. Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

- [Document parsing API](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/models/medical-document-parsing/introduction)

## One request in full

POST /med-link/nel/link, from [its page](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/models/medical-entity-codification/link-entity).

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.eka.care/med-link/nel/link' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
  "query": "chest pain",
  "ontology": "snomed",
  "version": "20250401_extended",
  "top_k": 3
}'
```
